subject: The Ultimate Machine
body:
An Ultimate Machine Core! I tried to make one once and only got as far as the Prometheum before the entire lab spontaneously combusted. Hence why I'm making you build it! Good luck mate. Here's the recipe, no pressure. @archive:integrated_boogaloo:tech_prometheum @display:integrated_boogaloo:guide/ultimate_core

Your old friend,
Dr. T
